headline: World Bank Estimates Up to 3.1 Million Haitian Adults Lack Valid IDs
summary: Between 2.7 million and 3.1 million Haitian adults lack a valid national identity card, creating barriers to financial services, formal employment, and social protection.

impacts.name: Haiti
impacts.why: Lack of identification restricts financial inclusion and formal economic activity.
